name: GeoNest
description: An intelligent geospatial accommodation platform that leverages mapping technologies and machine learning to recommend the most suitable Accommodations and PGs around universities and educational institutions.

paragraphs: GeoNest is a full-stack web application for discovering, reviewing, and managing Paying Guest (PG) accommodations with real-time geospatial search, AI voice search, intelligent chat assistance, and multi-factor recommendation scoring.
features: Fully responsive across mobile (360px+), tablet, and desktop viewports.
Touch-friendly slide-in navigation drawer with backdrop overlay, keyboard Escape handling, and route auto-close.
Mobile filter drawer / bottom sheet for seamless accommodation filtering.
Dual List View | Map View toggle on mobile with auto map.invalidateSize() refresh.
Touch-optimized Multi-Step Wizard for PG Listing creation with text-base input sizing to prevent iOS auto-zoom.

whatItDoes.text: GeoNest is a full-stack web application for discovering, reviewing, and managing Paying Guest (PG) accommodations with real-time geospatial search, AI voice search, intelligent chat assistance, and multi-factor recommendation scoring.
